changes.text: A stream calendar: every listed talent's streams for the week ahead, laid out by day and time in your own time zone. Live streams, streams running late and ones that already ended are easy to tell apart, and each talent links to their stock.
Streams with an open peak prediction carry a target mark, and the On air and Up next cards link straight to the bet.
Find it under Community in the menu, as a tab on the Livestreams page, and from the new On stream box on the market floor.
